Data extraction: JSON5 flat object (JSON superset with trailing commas and comments)

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"{
  host: "localhost",
  port: 8080,
}
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"data_extraction":true,"language":"json5"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let _ = process(source, &config);
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
    println!("{:?}", result.data.as_ref().unwrap().kind);
}
```
